Explain the example for use a store without react

blocks.text: A vanilla Zustand store can be used by ordinary JavaScript. It provides getState, setState and subscribe methods.
Use a React project with Zustand 5 installed. Hook examples belong in React components; vanilla examples use zustand/vanilla. These package imports require your own build tool.

items: The vanilla Zustand entry point creates a store object without a React hook. Use its getState, setState and subscribe methods.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A vanilla store is not a React hook. Use the matching API for the type of store you created.
